# goslop text fixture — generic except logs with exc_info (CourtScrapper FP)
lang: python
file: CWE-396-batch3-exc-info-safe.py
---
import logging

logger = logging.getLogger("pool")

def scrape_one(name):
    try:
        return do_scrape(name)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error("%s error: %s", name, e, exc_info=True)
        return (False, e)
